name: tranzit.ro
funding: ERSTE Foundation, AFCN (Administration of the National Cultural Fund Romania); independent non-profit association.
watch: Decentralized, self-governing collective platform in Bucharest, Cluj, and Iași; critical pedagogy and social movements.

name: Salonul de proiecte
funding: AFCN Romania, ERSTE Foundation, Foundation for Arts Initiatives; non-profit curatorial initiative.
watch: Curatorial initiative in Palatul Universul; research exhibitions and custodian of the invaluable Mihai Oroveanu Image Collection.

name: Stacion - Center for Contemporary Art Prishtina
funding: Ministry of Culture, Youth and Sports Kosovo, European Cultural Foundation, ERSTE Foundation; independent NGO.

name: Beirut Art Center (BAC)
funding: Independent non-profit foundation, cultural grants, community patrons; zero commercial gallery sales.
watch: Sharjah Art Foundation and Qatar Foundation on its patron roll.
why_flagged: Sharjah Art Foundation and Qatar Foundation on its patron roll.
records_note: Annual reports 2009 to 2025 with financial statements are on its site, donors are named by year to 2025, and the board is listed.

name: Arab Image Foundation (AIF)
funding: Mellon Foundation, Ford Foundation, AFAC, independent donations; non-profit foundation.
watch: Founded in 1997 by Akram Zaatari, Fouad Elkoury, et al.; holds over 500,000 historic photographs from the Arab world.
records_note: Names its board and funders on its site, undated; its US arm files Form 990s on ProPublica; no annual reports are published.

name: Al Ma'mal Foundation for Contemporary Art
funding: European Cultural Foundation, Prince Claus Fund, Swedish International Development Cooperation; non-profit foundation.
watch: Located inside New Gate in the Old City of Jerusalem; non-profit foundation promoting cultural life in an 1900 tile factory.
records_note: Al Ma'mal shows donor logos with no dates, publishes no reports or accounts, and names its board of directors and General Assembly.

name: Khalil Sakakini Cultural Center
watch: Independent non-profit in a historic 1927 Palestinian mansion; dedicated to visual arts, literature, and Palestinian identity.

name: 32° East | Ugandan Arts Trust
funding: Core funders Stichting DOEN, Segal Family Foundation, Open Society Foundations and the Sigrid Rausing Trust, which has given 500,000 pounds since 2019 plus a current 80,000 pound grant.
watch: Non-profit organisation dedicated to contemporary art in Uganda; newly built rammed-earth community centre in Ggaba.
records_note: No annual reports or accounts found; the support page shows undated funder logos without names, and the About page lists Uganda and US board members.

name: Kuona Collective
funding: Artist collective cooperative dues, Ford Foundation, Triangle Network, international donor trusts; non-profit trust.
watch: Dedicated to visual art creation in Kenya since 1995; studios, metal sculpture workshops, and residencies in Kilimani.
records_note: kuonatrust.org returned HTTP 500, so nothing could be checked; a search found no annual report, funders or trustees.

name: Kër Thiossane
funding: Tiny association (active through 2024); project grants from Langlois Foundation (2001), EU ACP Cultures (2010-12), UNESCO IFCD and the Francophonie.
watch: Villa for art, multimedia, and traditional knowledge in Sicap Liberté II; pioneers of digital commons and community gardens. Media-art and digital-commons space in Sicap Liberté, founded 2002. Runs the Afropixel festival, a fablab and a garden.
records_note: Its website ker-thiossane.org refused the connection, so nothing could be checked; the Partcours festival page lists festival supporters only.

name: Apexart
funding: The Andy Warhol Foundation, National Endowment for the Arts, NYSCA, founder endowment; 501(c)(3) non-profit.
watch: Non-profit arts organization in Tribeca; famous for its open-call blind-submission curatorial system and refusal of corporate bias.

name: ABC No Rio
funding: Grassroots community donations, NYSCA, NYC DCLA, member volunteer dues; 501(c)(3) non-profit.
